```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse=TRUE, comment="#>")
library(CCAflow)
```

A manuscript-ready analysis should report fit, interpretation, uncertainty/stability and generalization.

```{r, eval=requireNamespace("ggplot2",quietly=TRUE)}
d <- cca_agri_data(seed=15)
fit <- cca_ridge(d$X,d$Y,.15,.15,ncomp=3)
cv <- cca_validate(d$X,d$Y,"ridge",list(lambda_x=.15,lambda_y=.15,ncomp=3),folds=5,repeats=2,seed=15)
cca_plot(fit,"dual_circle")
cca_plot(cv)
cca_table(fit,"cross_loadings")
```

Use vector PDF/SVG where possible and TIFF/PNG at appropriate journal resolution with `cca_export()`.
